description:
Roles and Responsibilities: 
 1. Possess strong hands on skills as a Lead developer with highly transactional / distributed Gemfire caching solution.
 2. Possess strong hands on experience in designing, building & integrating custom web based applications using Java, Spring & Gemfire.
 3. Must be proficient in configuration, debugging, troubleshooting & deployment of Gemfire based solution in a clustered environment.
 4. Gemfire Administration experience would be a plus.


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6 months 
 
 INTERVIEW: PHONE
